session.title: Meeting report and 10-week action plan (18 Nov call and follow-up to 22 Nov)
session.participants: EduAakashaA mentor team, for Darsh and his parent
session.agenda:
1. Where things stand on 22 Nov
2. Decisions made and still open (HKU, NTU, NUS, IIT Abu Dhabi, Study in India, JEE Main, school exams)
3. JEE Main rules: attempt less, score more
4. School and ALLEN calendar clashes
5. Dated action plan to Feb 2027
6. Items to verify before anyone acts
session.shared_summary:
WHERE THINGS STAND (22 Nov 2026)
- NTU: application submitted on 19 Nov. Keep the confirmation and upload it to the portal.
- NUS: window 16 Dec 2026 to 17 Feb 2027. Upload the seven documents before it opens; internal target to submit by 31 Jan.
- HKU: first round closes 25 Nov. The call said both 'at least apply' and 'drop for now', so the family must give one clear answer by Tue 24 Nov: apply (submit and confirm the fee) or drop. The mentors' advice is one or two universities, not three.
- IIT Abu Dhabi (CAET): Darsh plans the January and April sessions. The window is said to open in December: mentors confirm the date and eligibility by 10 Dec.
- Study in India: last option. No interest registrations now; revisit in March or April. Where the form asks for nationality, choose Non Resident Indian.
- JEE Main: application submitted 4 Nov. Preparation now follows the day-by-day plan in the Study Planner.

JEE MAIN RULES
- Attempt only what you are 100% sure of; a wrong guess costs more than a skip.
- Order: Chemistry first (about 15 correct of 25), then Physics (about 10 correct of 25), then only the quick Maths questions (up to 5, sure ones only).
- Do not give Maths a fixed time block; use it as the filler.
- Mark every topic as sure, partly sure or not sure; partly sure means a formula is missing, so revise it.
- Two previous-year questions per subject every day. About 30 correct answers on a 75-question paper is a strong result.

CLASHES TO SETTLE
- Mon 30 Nov: the Maths model exam and ALLEN Part Test 1 fall on the same day.
- Pre-boards: Chemistry (22 Jan) and Maths (25 Jan) fall inside the JEE Main Session 1 window; the school agreed in principle to let Darsh skip a pre-board on a JEE day, in writing still to come.
- CBSE practicals 11 to 20 Jan overlap ALLEN tests on 13, 15 and 17 Jan.

NEXT STEPS
Settle HKU by 24 Nov. Get the school's written answers by 27 Nov. Follow the daily plan. After that the routine is two previous-year questions a day, one test a week and a short check-in each week.

TO VERIFY BEFORE ACTING
- Model exams: the call said they end on 16 Dec; the school PDF ends on 7 Dec.
- Chemistry and Computer Science practical dates (written as 9/10/26 and 11/10/26, which cannot be future dates).
- NUS (16 Dec to 17 Feb) and NTU (19 Mar) dates on the official portals.
- Which subjects Darsh takes (taken as Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Computer Science and English).
- Scores of 80 to 120 out of 300 are Darsh's own estimates, not verified.
- Fees and scholarship amounts: check the official sites.

actions.title: HKU decision: apply in the first round or formally drop it
actions.instruction: First round closes Wed 25 Nov (noon Hong Kong time, confirm with HKU). If applying: submit, pay the fee and send the confirmation. If dropping: tell the mentors in writing so the roadmap can be closed. The mentors' advice is one or two universities.

actions.title: Confirm the Monday check-in (23 Nov, 8:00 PM Dubai time)
actions.instruction: Reply in the Members Group so the mentors can send the meeting link.

actions.title: Keep the NTU confirmation on file and upload it to the portal
actions.instruction: The NTU application was submitted on 19 Nov. Upload the confirmation page or email so the mentors can check it against the application.

actions.title: Get the school's written answers: model-exam end date, all practical dates and the pre-board skip
actions.instruction: Ask the school to confirm in writing (1) whether the model exams end on 7 Dec (school PDF) or 16 Dec (said in the call), (2) the Chemistry and Computer Science practical dates, (3) that a pre-board falling on a JEE Main day can be skipped. Send the answers to the mentors.

actions.title: Decide the Maths model exam against ALLEN Part Test 1 on Mon 30 Nov
actions.instruction: Both fall on the same day. Choose which one gets full effort, tell the mentors, and the plan will be adjusted.

actions.title: Verify the NUS and NTU dates on the official portals
actions.instruction: NUS 16 Dec 2026 to 17 Feb 2027 and NTU 19 Mar 2027 (the NTU close varies by qualification). Update the calendar and tell the family if anything differs.

actions.title: Verify the IIT Abu Dhabi (CAET) January session window and eligibility
actions.instruction: The call says the window opens in December. Confirm the exact opening and closing dates and send them to the family.

actions.title: Confirm whether the CBC projects and Trinity certificates count for NUS and NTU
actions.instruction: Check each university's page on projects, competitions and certificates and tell the family which evidence helps.

actions.title: Keep a dated log of projects, competitions and leadership roles, with proof
actions.instruction: One line each: what, when, your role, and a certificate or link. NUS looks beyond marks, and the log is what you talk from in an interview.

actions.title: Prepare to explain your projects and achievements in five minutes
actions.instruction: An NTU or NUS online interview or test is possible but not every applicant is called. Practise out loud with the mentors.

actions.title: When any offer letter arrives, do not pay a deposit until the family has compared all offers
actions.instruction: Deposits are non-refundable and offers come at different times. Read the accept-by date on each offer and ask the mentors before paying.

actions.title: Revisit Study in India (March to April 2027)
actions.instruction: No interest registrations before then. When the form asks for nationality, choose Non Resident Indian, not UAE.
